annotations.title: Expand an image to a new shape

description: Extends an image beyond its edges to fit a new aspect ratio, filling the added area so it matches the original. Trained on licensed data. Compared with other image tools: mid-priced. Price: $0.055 per image, charged only on success. One call = one expanded image.

image.description: Image to expand (https URL). Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

prompt.description: Optional: what the added area should show
